standard: BISG Translation Rights Royalty Statement Standard
interpretation_note: The PDF lists 44 fields. It marks the five SC fields as 'conditional' and RA9 as '(if applicable)'. Con16/Con21 are described as 'populate only if Payer differs from Licensee'. RA14/RA19/RA24 are listed as best practice with situational triggers. Everything else is treated as required. The conditional classification below is this skill's reading of the standard, not BISG text.

locations.product_lines: array: one entry per product form (hardcover, ebook, ...)
locations.sublicenses: array: one entry per sublicensee (only if any exist)

fields.label: Licensee Name
fields.desc: Party that licensed rights and remits the statement

fields.label: Licensee Contact Information
fields.desc: Postal address, email, website URL, phone

fields.label: Licensee Imprint
fields.desc: Trade name under which Licensee publishes the work

fields.cond: Only when the Payer differs from the Licensee (e.g. parent company). Not a bank name.
fields.label: Payer Name
fields.desc: Party responsible for making payments

fields.label: Payer Contact Information
fields.desc: Postal address, email, website URL, phone

fields.label: Licensee Contract ID
fields.desc: Licensee-side unique contract reference

fields.label: Licensor Name
fields.desc: Rightsholder granting the rights

fields.label: Licensor Contract ID
fields.desc: Licensor-side unique contract reference

fields.label: Contributor Name(s)
fields.desc: Author/illustrator/series editor. Best practice: ISNI

fields.label: Licensor Title of Work
fields.desc: Title as published by Licensor (final, not preliminary)

fields.label: Licensee Title of Work
fields.desc: Title as published by Licensee (not necessarily literal translation)

fields.label: Language of Licensee Work
fields.desc: Language of the translated work; may be more than one

fields.label: Sales Territory
fields.desc: Where Licensee's edition was sold (may be 'home'/'export')

fields.label: Advance Amount
fields.desc: Total advances paid up to period end, incl. refresher advances

fields.label: Advance Currency
fields.desc: $, EUR, GBP, CNY etc. (AdvAmount is a numeral)

fields.label: Royalty Statement Date
fields.desc: Date statement was generated

fields.label: Royalty Reporting Period Start Date
fields.desc: Period start

fields.label: Royalty Reporting Period End Date
fields.desc: Period end

fields.label: Opening Balance
fields.desc: Prior Closing Balance if negative/unearned; 0 if paid last period

fields.label: Net Units Sold to Beginning of Period
fields.desc: Prior statement's Life-to-Date units, per product form

fields.label: Licensee Product Identifier
fields.desc: ISBN for books; alternate identifier for non-book products

fields.label: Product Form Detail
fields.desc: hardcover, paperback, ebook, audiobook...

fields.label: Licensee Publication Date
fields.desc: Date work was made available for sale, per product form

fields.label: Licensee List Price
fields.desc: Consumer price, per product form

fields.label: Royalty Rate
fields.desc: Percent or per-copy amount; include escalations

fields.label: Royalty Basis
fields.desc: List price, net sales amount, net receipts, etc.

fields.label: Units Sold in Period
fields.desc: Copies sold per product form; returns negative

fields.label: Royalty Earnings
fields.desc: Rate x Basis x Units per product form

fields.label: Total Royalty Earnings
fields.desc: Sum of all product-form royalties

fields.label: Life to Date Units Sold
fields.desc: UnitsSldinPer + NetUnitstoBegPer

fields.label: Reserve Withheld
fields.desc: Always 0 or negative

fields.label: Reserve Released
fields.desc: Always 0 or positive

fields.label: Closing Balance
fields.desc: Total royalty earnings + reserve withheld + reserve released + licensor sublicense amount

fields.label: Payment Due
fields.desc: Opening Balance + Closing Balance; negative = UNEARNED, positive = EARNED

fields.cond: If any subsidiary rights were sublicensed
fields.label: Sublicensee Name
fields.desc: Entity that acquired subsidiary rights

fields.cond: If any subsidiary rights were sublicensed
fields.label: Sublicense Type
fields.desc: Type of subsidiary right sublicensed

fields.cond: If any subsidiary rights were sublicensed
fields.label: Sublicense Income
fields.desc: Full income received from each sublicensee in period

fields.cond: If any subsidiary rights were sublicensed
fields.label: Licensor Share of Sublicense Income
fields.desc: Percentage payable to Licensor

fields.cond: If any subsidiary rights were sublicensed
fields.label: Licensor Amount of Sublicense Income
fields.desc: Monetary amount due to Licensor

fields.label: ID Information
fields.desc: Best practice: Licensor Contract ID, Contributor Name(s), Licensor Title on remittance paperwork

fields.cond: If a local co-agent commission is deducted; show percentage and amount
fields.label: Co-Agent Commission Percentage
fields.desc: Agency commission deducted for local co-agent

fields.cond: Required when Licensee is in the European Union (VAT); otherwise confirm N/A
fields.label: Licensee VAT/tax identification number
fields.desc: Licensee VAT number

fields.cond: Show status in Licensee's country: not applicable; waived; or expiry date
fields.label: Licensor Tax Exemption Status
fields.desc: Licensor tax exemption status

fields.cond: If foreign income tax is withheld from Payment Due; show percentage and amount
fields.label: Licensor Tax Withheld Amount
fields.desc: Foreign income tax deducted
